commit.subject: LU-20438 build: Add autoconf checks for PCI P2P DMA
commit.message:
LU-20438 build: Add autoconf checks for PCI P2P DMA

Add autoconf checks to detect kernel and OFED support for
PCI P2P DMA and ib_dma_pci_p2p_dma_supported. Update build
files to define appropriate compatibility macros.

Change-Id: I7169dc29c7b4a022124f984f020f441e5ec1d2cd
Signed-off-by: Shivaji Kant <shivajikant@google.com>
